_readme: Source of truth for the Motion Bang Bang SFX bundle. Edit a prompt here, then run:
Existing files are skipped unless --force is given, so this doubles as an extend-the-library recipe.
duration_seconds is what you are billed for, not what you keep: 'tight' one-shots are
silence-trimmed afterwards, so request a little headroom and let the trim decide the length.
Prompts always name source + surface + mic perspective, and forbid musical content, because
a tonal stinger collides with any music bed added later.

mix._note: Relative to each asset's normalised -3 dBFS peak. Intensity is a mix-time parameter: every file in the bundle sits at the same peak on purpose, so a library click and a library impact differ only by what the mixer applies.
